atc.stdout:
usage: atc <args>
generate offline model example:
atc --model=./alexnet.prototxt --weight=./alexnet.caffemodel --framework=0 --output=./domi 
generate offline model for single op example:
atc --singleop=./op_list.json --output=./op_model 

===== Basic Functionality =====
[General]
  --h/help            Show this help message
  --mode              Run mode.
                       0: default, generate offline model;
                       1: convert model to JSON format;
                       3: only pre-check;
                       5: convert ge dump txt file to JSON format;
                       6: display model info;
                       30: convert original graph to execute-om for nano(offline model)

[Input]
  --distributed_cluster_build            build model for distribute mode or not
  --model             Model file
  --weight            Weight file. Required when framework is Caffe
  --om                The model file to be converted to json
  --framework         Framework type. 0:Caffe; 1:MindSpore; 3:Tensorflow; 5:Onnx
  --input_format      Format of input data. E.g.: "NCHW"
  --input_shape       Shape of static input data or shape range of dynamic input. Separate multiple nodes with semicolons (;). Use double quotation marks (") to enclose each argument.
                      E.g.: "input_name1:n1,c1,h1,w1;input_name2:n2,c2,h2,w2"
                            "input_name1:n1~n2,c1,h1,w1;input_name2:n3~n4,c2,h2,w2"
  --input_shape_range This option is deprecated and will be removed in future version, please use input_shape instead.Shape range of input data. Separate multiple nodes with semicolons (;).
                      Use double quotation marks (") to enclose each argument.
                      E.g.: "input_name1:[n1~n2,c1,h1,w1];input_name2:[n2,c2~c3,h2,w2]"
  --dynamic_batch_size Set dynamic batch size. E.g.: "batchsize1,batchsize2,batchsize3"
  --dynamic_image_size Set dynamic image size. Separate multiple nodes with semicolons (;). Use double quotation marks (") to enclose each argument.
                       E.g.: "imagesize1_height,imagesize1_width;imagesize2_height,imagesize2_width"
  --dynamic_dims      Set dynamic dims. Separate multiple nodes with semicolons (;). Use double quotation marks (") to enclose each argument.
                       E.g.: "dims1_n1,dims1_n2;dims2_n1,dims2_n2"
  --singleop          Single op definition file. atc will generate offline.model(s) for single op if --singleop is set.
  --shard_model_dir              dictionary of split models
  --model_relation_config        relation of split models
  --enable_graph_parallel        whether to enable parallel
  --graph_parallel_option_path   parallel strategy configuration file
  --cluster_config               logic cluster configuration of target environment

[Output]
  --output            Output file path&name(needn't suffix, will add .om/.exeom automatically).
                      If --model is set to 30, an additional dbg file will be generated.
                      If --singleop is set, this arg specifies the directory to which the single op offline model will be generated.
  --output_type       Set net output type. Support FP32, FP16, UINT8, INT8. E.g.: FP16, indicates that all out nodes are set to FP16.
                      "node1:0:FP16;node2:1:FP32", indicates setting the datatype of multiple out nodes.
  --check_report      The pre-checking report file. Default value is: "check_result.json"
  --json              The output json file path&name which is converted from a model
  --host_env_os            OS type of the target execution environment.
                           The parameters that support setting are the OS types of the opp package
                           Supported host env os as list:
                           minios linux 
                           default: linux
  --host_env_cpu           CPU type of the target execution environment.
                           The parameters that support setting are the CPU types of the opp package
                           Supported host env cpu as list:
                           support cpu: aarch64 , respond to os: minios
                           support cpu: aarch64 x86_64 , respond to os: linux
                           default: aarch64

[Target]
  --soc_version       The soc version.
  --virtual_type      Set whether offline model can run on the virtual devices under compute capability allocation.
                      0 (default) : Disable virtualization; 1 : Enable virtualization.
  --core_type         Set core type AiCore or VectorCore. VectorCore: use vector core. Default value is: AiCore
  --aicore_num        Set aicore num
===== Advanced Functionality =====
[Feature]
  --out_nodes         Output nodes designated by users. Separate multiple nodes with semicolons (;).Use double quotation marks (") to enclose each argument.
                      E.g.: "node_name1:0;node_name1:1;node_name2:0"
  --input_fp16_nodes  Input node datatype is fp16. Separate multiple nodes with semicolons (;). Use double quotation marks (") to enclose each argument. E.g.: "node_name1;node_name2"
  --insert_op_conf    Config file to insert new op
  --op_name_map       Custom op name mapping file
                      Note: A semicolon(;) cannot be included in each path, otherwise the resolved path will not match the expected one.
  --is_input_adjust_hw_layout    Intput node datatype is fp16 and format is NC1HWC0, used with input_fp16_nodes. E.g.: "true,true,false,true"
  --is_output_adjust_hw_layout   Net output node datatype is fp16 and format is NC1HWC0, used with out_nodes. E.g.: "true,true,false,true"
  --external_weight        Convert const to file constant, and save weight in file.
                           0 (default): save weight in om.  1: save weight in file.

[Model Tuning]
  --disable_reuse_memory    The switch of reuse memory. Default value is : 0. 0 means reuse memory, 1 means do not reuse memory.
  --fusion_switch_file      Set fusion switch file path
  --enable_scope_fusion_passes    validate the non-general scope fusion passes, multiple names can be set and separated by ','. E.g.: ScopePass1,ScopePass2,...
  --enable_single_stream    Enable single stream. true: enable; false(default): disable
  --enable_small_channel    Set enable small channel. 0(default): disable; 1: enable
  --enable_compress_weight  Enable compress weight. true: enable; false(default): disable
  --compress_weight_conf    Config file to compress weight
  --compression_optimize_conf    Config file to compress optimize
  --sparsity                Optional; enable structured sparse. 0(default): disable; 1: enable
  --buffer_optimize         Set buffer optimize. Support "l2_optimize" (default), "l1_optimize", "off_optimize"
  --mdl_bank_path           Set the path of the custom repository generated after model tuning.

[Operator Tuning]
  --op_precision_mode     Set the path of operator precision mode configuration file (.ini)
  --allow_hf32            enable hf32. false: disable; true: enable.
  --precision_mode        precision mode, support force_fp16(default), force_fp32, cube_fp16in_fp32out, allow_mix_precision, allow_fp32_to_fp16, must_keep_origin_dtype, allow_mix_precision_fp16, allow_mix_precision_bf16, allow_fp32_to_bf16.
  --precision_mode_v2     precision mode v2, support fp16, origin, cube_fp16in_fp32out, mixed_float16, mixed_bfloat16.
  --modify_mixlist        Set the path of operator mixed precision configuration file.
  --keep_dtype            Retains the precision of certain operators in inference scenarios by using a configuration file.
  --customize_dtypes      Set the path of custom dtypes configuration file.
  --op_bank_path          Set the path of the custom repository generated after operator tuning with Auto Tune.
  --op_select_implmode    Set op select implmode. Support high_precision, high_performance, high_precision_for_all, high_performance_for_all. default: high_performance
  --optypelis

msprof.stdout:
Usage:
      ./msprof [--options]

Options:
      --output                          <Optional> Specify the directory that is used for storing data results.(full-platform)
      --storage-limit                   <Optional> Specify the output directory volume. range 200MB ~ 4294967296MB.(full-platform)
      --application                     <Optional> Specify application path, considering the risk of privilege escalation,
						   please pay attention to the group of the application and 
						   confirm whether it is the same as the user currently.(full-platform)
      --ascendcl                        <Optional> Show acl profiling data, the default value is on.(full-platform)
      --model-execution                 <Optional> Show ge model execution profiling data, the default value is off.(full-platform)
      --runtime-api                     <Optional> Show runtime api profiling data, the default value is off.(full-platform)
      --task-time                       <Optional> Show task profiling data, the default value is on.(full-platform)
						   The switch can be set in range [l0, l1, on, off]
      --environment                     <Optional> User app custom environment variable configuration.(full-platform)
      --sys-period                      <Optional> Set total sampling period of system profiling in seconds.(full-platform)
      --sys-devices                     <Optional> Specify the profiling scope by device ID when collect sys profiling.
						   The value is all or ID list (split with ',').(full-platform)
      --hccl                            <Optional> Show hccl profiling data, the default value is off.(full-platform)
      --msproftx                        <Optional> Show msproftx data, the default value is off.(full-platform)
      --ai-core                         <Optional> Turn on / off the ai core profiling, the default value is on when collecting
						   app Profiling.(full-platform)
      --aic-mode                        <Optional> Set the aic profiling mode to task-based or sample-based.(full-platform)
						   In task-based mode, profiling data will be collected by tasks.
						   In sample-based mode, profiling data will be collected in a specific interval.
						   The default value is task-based.
      --aic-freq                        <Optional> The aic sampling frequency in hertz, the default value is 100 Hz, the range is
						   1 to 100 Hz.(full-platform)
      --aic-metrics                     <Optional> The aic metrics groups, include ArithmeticUtilization, PipeUtilization, Memory,
						   MemoryL0, ResourceConflictRatio, MemoryUB, L2Cache, PipelineExecuteUtilization.
						   You can also customize registers in the format of Custom:xx,xx.
						   The default value is PipelineExecuteUtilization.(full-platform)
      --dynamic                         <Optional> Dynamic profiling switch, the default value is off.(Ascend910)
      --pid                             <Optional> Dynamic profiling pid of the target process.(Ascend910)
      --python-path                     <Optional> Specify the python interpreter path that is used for analysis, please
						   ensure the python version is 3.7.5 or later.(full-platform)
      --analyze                         <Optional> Switch for using msprof to analyze collecting data, the default value
						   is off.(full-platform)
      --rule                            <Optional> Switch specified rule for using msprof to analyze collecting data, the default value
						   is communication,communication_matrix.(full-platform)
						   The switch can be set in [communication, communication_matrix]
      --parse                           <Optional> Switch for using msprof to parse collecting data, the default value
						   is off.(full-platform)
      --query                           <Optional> Switch for using msprof to query collecting data, the default value
						   is off.(full-platform)
      --export                          <Optional> Switch for using msprof to export collecting data, the default value
						   is off.(full-platform)
      --clear                           <Optional> Swith for using msprof to analyze or export data in clear mode, the default value
						   is off.(full-platform)
      --iteration-id                    <Optional> The export iteration id, only uesd when argument export is on,
						   the default value is 1
      --model-id                        <Optional> The export model id, only uesd when argument export is on, msprof will
						   export minium accessible model by default.(full-platform)
      --summary-format                  <Optional> The export summary file format, only uesd when argument export is on,
						   include csv, json, the default value is csv.(full-platform)
      --aicpu                           <Optional> Show aicpu profiling data, the default value is off.(full-platform)
      --sys-hardware-mem                <Optional> LLC, DDR, HBM acquisition switch, optional on / off, the default value is off.
						   LLC bandwidth(Ascend310 while set llc-profiling to bandwidth).
						   LLC usage by aicpu and control cpu(Ascend310 while set llc-profiling to capacity).
						   LLC read/write speed(Ascend310P, Ascend910, Ascend310B, Ascend910B).
						   DDR read/write speed(Ascend310, Ascend310P, Ascend910, Ascend310B).
						   HBM read/write speed(Ascend910, Ascend910B).
						   Processes-level and system-level device memory usage(full-platform)
      --sys-hardware-mem-freq           <Optional> LLC, DDR, HBM acquisition frequency, range 1 ~ 100, the default value is 50 Hz
      --llc-profiling                   <Optional> The llc profiling groups.
						   include capacity, bandwidth. the default value is capacity.(Ascend310)
						   include read, write. the default value is read.(Ascend310P, Ascend910, Ascend310B, Ascend910B)
      --sys-cpu-profiling               <Optional> The CPU acquisition switch, optional on / off, the default value
						   is off.(full-platform)
      --sys-cpu-freq                    <Optional> The cpu sampling frequency in hertz. the default value
						   is 50 Hz, the range is 1 to 50 Hz.(full-platform)
      --sys-profiling                   <Optional> The System CPU usage and system memory acquisition switch,
						   the default value is off.(full-platform)
      --sys-sampling-freq               <Optional> The sys sampling frequency in hertz. the default value
						   is 10 Hz, the range is 1 to 10 Hz.(full-platform)
      --sys-pid-profiling               <Optional> The CPU usage of the process and the memory acquisition
						   switch of the process, the default value is off.(full-platform)
      --sys-pid-sampling-freq           <Optional> The pid sampling frequency in hertz. the default value is 10 Hz,
						   the range is 1 to 10 Hz.(full-platform)
      --sys-io-profiling                <Optional> NIC ROCE acquisition switch, the default value is off.
						   NIC(Ascend310, Ascend910, Ascend310B, Ascend910B), ROCE(Ascend910, Ascend910B)
      --sys-io-sampling-freq            <Optional> NIC ROCE acquisition frequency, range 1 ~ 100, the default value is 100 Hz.
						   NIC(Ascend310, Ascend910, Ascend310B, Ascend910B), ROCE(Ascend910, Ascend910B)
      --dvpp-profiling                  <Optional> DVPP acquisition switch, the default value is off.(full-platform)
      --dvpp-freq                       <Optional> DVPP acquisition frequency, range 1 ~ 100, the default value is 50 Hz.(full-platform)
      --l2                              <Optional> L2 Cache acquisition switch. the default value is off.(Ascend310P, Ascend910, Ascend310B, Ascend910B)
      --help                            <Optional> help message.(full-platform)
